seasons.season_description: The original Rainbow Six Siege experience, with all the operators and maps from the first year of the game.
Continue the Siege with the first major content update, Operation Black Ice, which gives you access to the new Yacht map, two new JTF2 operators.
The Siege continues with Operation Dust Line, which introduces the new Border map and two new Navy SEAL operators.
The Siege continues with Operation Skull Rain, which introduces the new favela map and two new BOPE operators.
The Siege continues with Operation Red Crow, which introduces the new skyscraper map and two new SAT operators.
The Siege continues with Operation Velvet Shell, which introduces the new coastline map and two new GEO operators.

Operation Health is a unique season focused on improving the overall health of Rainbow Six Siege. This season will include a variety of updates and improvements to the game, including bug fixes, performance enhancements, and quality of life changes.
The Siege continues with Operation Blood Orchid, which introduces the new theme park map and three new operators from the Hong Kong Special Duties Unit.
The Siege continues with Operation White Noise, which introduces the new skyscraper map and three new operators from the South Korean 707th Special Mission Battalion.
The Siege continues with Operation Chimera, which introduces the new Outbreak event and two new operators from NRBC

event.event_description: The Outbreak Event took place in Truth or Consequences, New Mexico, with Rainbow tackling the epidemic that is ravaging the town. Teams of three are sent to combat the threat.

seasons.season_description: The Siege continues with Operation Para Bellum, which introduces the new Villa map and two new operators from the Italian GIS.
The Siege continues with Operation Grim Sky, which introduces two new operators from the ITUGS.

event.event_description: Mad House is a unique Halloween-themed gamemode and map that was available for a limited time in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege during the Operation Grim Sky expansion. For the Mad House Event, the House map had been revamped to feature Halloween decorations, such as Jack-o-lanterns, gargoyles, and cobwebs. A fog covers most of the map and eerie sounds can be heard. The mode follows the standard Bomb mode.

seasons.season_description: The Siege continues with Operation Wind Bastion, which introduces two new operators from the Moroccan GIGR and the new Fortress map.
